name: DWD: Drunk Wizard Dungeoneer
detailed_description:
An action-packed, booze-fuelled, hilariously unpredictable roguelite where every potion is both your weapon and your curse. 

Step into the chaotic boots of Tipsy, a high-functioning potion-loving wizard on a wild quest in the ever-shifting dungeon. Every room, every run, and every sip is a gamble:  Drink too much and your magic goes wild; drink too little and your reality starts to unravel. You will need wit, courage, and a strong liver to outsmart danger and master your spells. Are you ready to prove you’re more than just a barstool legend? 

🍷 ALCHEMICAL ADDICTION - A UNIQUE GAMEPLAY MECHANIC 

Balance is everything. Your Blood Potion Concentration (BPC) isn’t just a stat—it’s a wild gameplay mechanic. Drink too little and suffer psychotic withdrawal; drink too much and your spells go haywire. Every sip is a dare; every combo could be your last. Will you ride the buzz or spiral into chaos? 

💥 ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY- NEVER THE SAME DUNGEON TWICE 

No two delves are ever the same, and every run is a new challenge. Journey through a variety of unique biomes filled with unexpected encounters. Every run offers randomly generated dungeons packed with fresh enemies, unique drops, and surprises to keep you coming back for "just one more run." Adapt, improvise, and juggle your brews wisely to make it to the next level. 

🌪️ HILARIOUS CHAOTIC SPELLCASTING – MAGIC ON THE EDGE 

The line between genius and disaster is razor-thin. Tipsy’s spellcasting is as wild as his drinking habits. One moment you’re unleashing genius-level combos, the next you’re triggering magical mayhem. Expect the unexpected—sometimes your best-laid plans can turn into glorious disasters in the blink of an eye. 

🏆 REAL STAKES – TRUE ROGUELITE PROGRESSION   

Death is permanent, but every run teaches you something new. Unlock wild elemental combos, discover powerful upgrades, and push deeper into the Infinite Dungeon. Each victory is hard-won; each defeat is a lesson in magical excess.  

🤝 4-PLAYER MAYHEM – BRING FRIENDS, BRING CHAOS 

Why brave the madness alone? Team up with up to three friends for a co-op experience that’s pure, unfiltered pandemonium. Strategize your drinking, share potions, rescue your buddies (or just laugh as their spells backfire), and see how far your party can spiral before the Infinite Dungeon claims another round of victims.

  • Processor: Dual Core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950 or Radeon R7 360
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad Core 2.4ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 or Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
